generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Entity ImpactDamageSubcomponentDefinition
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Deals damage to the entity that was hit and optionally applies knockback, fire, channeling, and critical-hit scaling.

fields.title: Apply Knockback To Blocking Targets
fields.description: If `true`, knockback is still applied to targets that successfully blocked the hit.

fields.title: Catch Fire
fields.description: If `true`, the entity hit is set on fire (uses the projectile's `on_fire_time`).

fields.title: Ceil Pre Critical Damage
fields.description: If `true`, rounds the projectile's damage up to the next integer before the critical-hit multiplier is applied.

fields.title: Channeling
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile can call down a lightning bolt on the entity hit during a thunderstorm.

fields.title: Damage
fields.description: Range of damage to apply on impact. A random value in `[min, max]` is rolled per hit and the velocity-scaled `power_multiplier` term is added to it to define the projectile's base damage.

fields.title: Destroy On Hit
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile is removed when it deals damage to an entity.

fields.title: Destroy On Hit Requires Damage
fields.description: If `true`, `destroy_on_hit` only triggers when at least one point of damage is actually dealt (targets that fully absorb damage will not destroy the projectile).

fields.title: Difficulty Randomization
fields.description: Controls how world difficulty contributes to the rolled damage. `none` ignores difficulty, `additive` adds a difficulty-driven term on top of the base damage, and `multiplicative` folds the difficulty term into `power_multiplier` before scaling by velocity.

fields.title: Filter
fields.description: Entity family or type that the projectile is restricted to damaging. Entities outside the filter are not damaged.

fields.title: Knockback
fields.description: If `true`, the entity hit is knocked back away from the projectile.

fields.title: Max Critical Damage
fields.description: If specified, sets the maximum damage after critical damage has been applied. Enchantments have already been applied at this point, so this clamps the final damage value of critical hits.

fields.title: Min Critical Damage
fields.description: If specified, sets the minimum damage after critical damage has been applied. Enchantments have already been applied at this point, so this clamps the final damage value of critical hits.

fields.title: Power Multiplier
fields.description: Multiplied by the projectile's velocity and added to the rolled `damage` to define the projectile's base damage, so it can be used on its own to scale damage by the projectile's velocity.

fields.title: Set Last Hurt Requires Damage
fields.description: If `true`, the projectile only registers as the last hurt-by source on the target when at least one point of damage is actually dealt.
